data.description:
Metacity Patrol: Explore. Investigate. Liberate.

(Early access - still in development)

Step into the neon-soaked, dystopian world of Metacity. In a future where synthetics walk amongst the living.

As a new recruit in Metacity Law Enforcement, free fly in your air car around the miles of sky above Metacity's urban sprawl, with over 100 locations to land, explore, and free roam on foot.

Fight a crime wave of illegally modified synthetics, respond to HQ calls in real-time, collect evidence, interrogate suspects, uncover a criminal underworld, and liberate Metacity.

Rise through the ranks and earn money to spend on implants, upgrades, property, and anything else for sale around Metacity. Alternatively, go off duty and experience life as a Metacitizen, check out the entertainment districts, test your flying skills in street races, or just relax and explore the city.

Personalize your weapon and gloves to suit your style. Buy property, upgrade your air car for better performance, and invest in cutting-edge implant technology to sharpen your stats.

changelog.change_log:
- Story based missions added (more to come!)
- 80 explorable upper city buildings added
- Additional air car control settings added
- New air car window upgrades available in HQ garage
- Basketball backstreet added with leaderboard
- 2 new races added with leaderboards
- NPC clothing updated
- Siren light effects added
- 'Request mission' button added to HQ and properties
- Many bug fixes!

- New area added (Tech Zone), with hospital and new apartment
- Air car speed booster upgrades and charging stations added
- Improved racing with leaderboards
- Thermal scanner upgrade added - scan buildings for criminal activity
- New missions;  Armed synthetics, Suspect interrogation, Building scan.
- Improved lighting effects
- Health system added, upgrades become damaged when injured.
- All legacy buildings remodelled
- Customizable gloves
- Umbrellas!

- MAJOR GRAPHICS UPDATE THROUGHOUT METACITY!
- NEW CAR MODELS
- NEW PLAYER HANDS & GUN MODELS
- NEW NPC MODELS
- TECH BLEU & MARKET ZONE UPDATED
- NEW ZONE ADDED - 'INDUSTRIAL'
- NEW HQ AREAS ADDED
- QUEST 3 RESOLUTION BOOST
- MANY BUG FIXES!

Extra content:

Purchasable property! - You can now use your in game credits to buy a property in the Residential Zone, and also an Upper City penthouse near the Theatre Sector. Both properties can be furnished, and used as save game locations. Keep an eye out for the 'For Sale' signs!

More Lower City locations added! - Backstreet locations added, these don't appear in your HUD, but can be discovered when exploring the Upper City where you see their landing beacons. You will also occasionally get sent on missions to these locations.


Gameplay updates:

Brightness boost option - If the games is a little too dark for you, give the brightness a boost! The option can be found on your aircar console.

Auto-reload - Returning to your aircar to reload is no longer required. You gun automatically reloads when out of ammo. Gun now has LED readout to display remaining ammo.

Virtual cockpit joysticks. As well as using the thumb sticks, you can now tilt the controllers to work as virtual joysticks to control aircar rotation and altitude when holding the grip button. Or use a combination of thumbstick and tilt controls, whichever works best for you.

Car locator - you can now add the location of your car to your HUD, no more losing your car in the Lower City! Option available on your aircar console, or by pressing 'X' when on foot (HUD must be active to see car location).

Smooth turning speed increased when on foot.

Sit/Crouch button added (right thumbstick) - Added button to allow you to sit in your newly purchased home!

Reset progress button added - You can now reset your game progress completely by pressing the reset button 3 time in Police HQ. This does not reset your game save data, unless you save your game after pressing this button!"

Balanced XP and upgrade pricing.


Bug fixes: 

'Total money earned' stat glitch fixed

Ammo glitch fixed - when ammo upgrades have been purchased, game now starts with correct amount of ammo in your gun.

Synthetics spawning in inaccessible places fixed.

Some graphical glitches fixed.
